    • taskSchedulingExample

      public static void taskSchedulingExample()
      Simple task scheduling example using a priority queue. Priority queue is useful when you need to process items based on priority rather than arrival order. The poll() method always retrieves the highest-priority item.

    • slidingWindowExample

      public static void slidingWindowExample()
      Sliding window example implemented with ArrayDeque. Explanations: here we maintain a fixed-size window of the last N elements seen. A sliding window is useful in scenarios like moving averages, rate limiting, etc. The strategy is to add new elements to the end and remove from the front when the size exceeds the limit.
